summary: Today is a mixed regulatory and business expansion day, driven by the RBI's new domestic money transfer framework and Reliance's ₹1,600-crore industrial investment in Karnataka. Significant debt market financing for corporate M&A and ambitious retail store rollouts further highlight aggressive market movements.

bullets.text: RBI issued the Domestic Money Transfer Directions 2026, permitting walk-in customers to transfer up to Rs 50,000 via NEFT.
Reliance laid the foundation for a ₹1,600-crore Campa Cola manufacturing plant spanning 109 acres in Vijayapura, Karnataka, creating 5,000 jobs.
Khaitan & Co advised Persistent Systems on a ₹7,600 crore financing package, including ₹7,000 crore NCDs, to acquire Nagarro SE.
Geeken planned a ₹350 crore manufacturing investment and 200 new stores to target ₹3,000 crore in revenue by 2030.
New Shop plans to open 25 stores in Bengaluru next quarter, targeting 200 total outlets across South India.
